name: Benchmark for Change
description: Benchmark intended to evaluate methods for detecting or quantifying changes in materials (e.g., phase, composition, or property changes).
reputation: A domain-specific benchmark for materials-change detection referenced in the literature; used within materials-science research but not a broadly standard ML benchmark.
notes: Non-LLM, domain-specific dataset — likely small to moderate size, sensitive to experimental/measurement noise; methods may require domain expertise to interpret; potential variability across measurement setups.
